connector.name: WhatsApp Chat Reader (Unofficial)
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial read-only MCP server for your local WhatsApp chat history (stays on your machine).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package wa-chat-reader. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nabheetcloud account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: WHATSAPP_DB_PATHS
env.description: Semicolon-separated paths to ChatStorage.sqlite. If unset, a platform default is used.

env.name: WHATSAPP_BACKUP_PATHS
env.description: Semicolon-separated fallback database paths, tried after the primary paths.

env.name: WHATSAPP_MAX_DAYS
env.description: Maximum look-back window in days a caller may request.

env.name: WHATSAPP_DEBUG
env.description: Set to 'true' for verbose logging to stderr.

env.name: WHATSAPP_LOG_FILE
env.description: Optional path to also write logs to a file.
